About Cockatiels Craze

Welcome to Cockatiels Craze — meet the flock

Cockatiels Craze is where our flock teaches your flock. Every guide here comes from daily life with our cockatiels — the singing, the mess, the worries at 2 a.m., and everything they keep teaching us.

On the channel, our flock teaches your flock. These books are the same lessons, written down properly: clear, honest and step by step, so you can keep them beside the cage and come back whenever you need them.
